subject: op-spd
title: (R)OP.SPD.------VT.PLT.
description: Chart on book p. 150 (SR(TRS)II-6). OP-SPD (option spread) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; VT-PLT (vibrational platform) is the partner. From the subject: DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism) and AFI (affinity insight). From DYM-SPT: ALT-ACT (alternative activism). From AFI: WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). From WO-EXP-PRI: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From RT-DY: EXT-DYM (extended dynamics).
